# `uscode_editions`

**Retained U.S. Code edition members**

One native annual or release-point archive member observed in its edition. Requested year, native publication year, carried-forward state and appendices remain separate.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Selected retained original archive members only; edition membership and source structure do not establish complete section-body qualification. *(measured 2026-10-10)*

- **Parquet file:** `uscode_editions.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `edition_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reader identity of one retained archive member and edition observation. |
| `source_kind` | `VARCHAR` | Original annual XHTML or release-point USLM source kind. |
| `requested_year` | `VARCHAR` | Annual year requested by the source selection; distinct from native publication year. |
| `release_point` | `VARCHAR` | Native release-point label selected for this observation. |
| `archive_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the retained original archive bytes. |
| `member_name` | `VARCHAR` | Original archive member name; source locator, not a local filesystem path. |
| `member_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the exact decoded original archive member. |
| `member_bytes` | `VARCHAR` | Decoded archive member size in bytes. |
| `title` | `VARCHAR` | Source title number. |
| `native_publication_year` | `VARCHAR` | Publication year stated by this native member. |
| `carried_forward` | `VARCHAR` | Reader-recorded carried-forward state of this archive member. |
| `member_role` | `VARCHAR` | Native member role within its edition, including carried appendices. |
| `metadata_json` | `VARCHAR` | Native edition/member metadata retained as JSON. |
